name: io.github.GyeongHoKim/gerrit-mcp-server
title: Gerrit
description: Gerrit code review for AI agents: find changes, read diffs, draft comments and publish reviews.

environmentVariables.name: GERRIT_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Gerrit host

environmentVariables.name: GERRIT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Auth token from Settings → HTTP Credentials

environmentVariables.name: GERRIT_ALLOW_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to enable the tools that modify Gerrit

environmentVariables.name: GERRIT_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log level. Logs go to stderr
